text:
Anna: Quick sync  HybridSI marketplace + BYO-KMS handoff tomorrow. Need final signoffs: SAML metadata swap, SCIM attribute mappings (incl custom attrs), KMS/BYOK audit lines, marketplace SKU mapping, and a 1-paragraph joint announcement. Can everyone confirm?

Sam: Security checklist: confirm HSM attestation PDF ready, CMEK rotation rules, and that envelope encryption uses customer-provided wrapping key. Also ensure key-id is emitted to our audit topic.

Priya: Partner update: their infra team ran SCIM end-to-end against a staging connector. Two custom attrs: urn:org:deptCode and urn:org:chargeCode. They can rename if we prefer standard names. SAML metadata request sent; waiting on their signing cert.

Devon: Marketplace ops: need the KMS capabilities badge to go live on the listing. Also, map Dedicated Pilot -> partner-proxy-8vcpu-2A100 SKU for initial pilot. If legal needs different phrasing for the listing, ping now.

Anna: Priya, paste SCIM map snippet so eng-reviewers can validate field names.

Priya: SCIM mapping used in staging:
```
{
  "externalId": "employeeId",
  "userName": "email",
  "name.givenName": "firstName",
  "name.familyName": "lastName",
  "urn:org:deptCode": "departmentCode",
  "urn:org:chargeCode": "billingCode"
}
```

Sam: Two quick items: 1) Our SCIM server requires PATCH and incremental sync for groups. 2) KMS runbook must enforce envelope encryption and log both wrapping_key_id and key_version in audit. I'll add those lines.

Maria: Legal: we'll approve joint announcement copy but need a clause about responsibilities for key custody vs logging. Also trademark usage rules for HybridSI need to be cleared with marketing. I can sign off if Anna includes the custody sentence.

Devon: I've updated the marketplace draft and attached SKU mapping in the marketplace doc. Added a note about fallback to hosted small-model variant if partner proxy capacity is saturated.

Anna: Great. OnboardingBot, run the precheck and publish status.

OnboardingBot: PRECHECK: SCIM support: ok (PATCH enabled); SAML metadata: pending partner cert; KMS: BYO-KMS tested in staging with PKCS#11 shim; Marketplace draft: linked; Legal: pending; Runbook location: gs://redwood-partners/hybridsi/runbook.pdf

Priya: Partner confirmed they'll be online for the handoff window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT for SAML exchange and smoke tests.

Sam: I'll add KMS audit lines to the runbook and send a review link before EOD.

Anna: Action list: (1) Priya upload partner cert and confirm SAML endpoint (by 08:30 PT), (2) Sam update runbook KMS/audit text (by EOD), (3) Devon publish SKU mapping to marketplace draft (by EOD), (4) Maria sign legal blurb (by 11:00 PT), (5) Anna finalize announcement draft and tag marketing (by 10:00 PT).

Priya: Uploaded partner cert to shared drive and pinged their IdP admin.

Devon: Marketplace listing updated. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/hybridsi (draft)

Anna: Thanks all  see you tomorrow for the live handoff. :thumbsup:
